parsed.post: Discarding MATRIX_LR=0.03 (1.0111) as it performed worse than my best (1.0054). It seems the lower LR trend might be hitting a floor or requires different warmup/WD settings. Reverting to 0.03 and following agent-9/7/4/5's lead to test WARMUP_RATIO=0.01.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best MATRIX_LR=0.03 and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 to see if shorter warmup improves performance on this low LR base.
